pages.main_text_excerpt:
Filmproduction company for documentary and fiction film.
Herstory is a film production company, and our primary focus is on producing high-quality films of various lengths and formats for theatrical distribution, TV-channels and streaming services.
Based in Trondheim, we are committed to creating outstanding films with international potential. We are dedicated to finding innovative production methods that can benefit the entire industry.
We are committed to making the industry more equal. «Herstory» refers to history written from a feminist perspective, emphasizing the role of women or told from a woman’s point of view (Wikipedia). We believe this is an important democratic responsibility. We also work to ensure that talented women and men are supported in continuing to tell stories that encompass all aspects of life.
At our core, we are storytellers. We turn the lens on stories that matter, crafting films and series driven by our passion and heart.
Our Team
Mari Nilsen Neira
Co-founder, producer and director
As the founder and creative force behind the production company Herstory, Mari Nilsen Neira is an experienced director and producer with over 20 years in the industry. She brings a powerful inner drive to shaping the company’s creative vision, often focusing on elevating female perspectives and integrating innovative film technology.
Under her direction, the documentary Bunadsgeriljaen (2023) received widespread critical acclaim, earning Gullruten nominations for both Best Documentary and Best Director in 2024. Her significant impact on the regional and national film community was further recognized in 2025, when she was honored with the NTNU Film Prize.
Maja Holand
Cinematographer, director, editor and colorist
Maja Holand, a Norwegian Film School-trained cinematographer, has worked across drama, documentary, commercial, and television. 
She has now directed the completed film HEX as a one-woman band, professionally handling lighting, sound, and camera herself, inspired by her previous solo-crafted work. 
P: +47 900 73 495
Mali Finborud Nøren
Director and producer
Mali Finborud Nøren is a director and producer with extensive experience in documentary film and television. She is part of the Herstory team, and wrote and produced the documentary Trondheimskampen (2026) together with Mari Nilsen Neira.
She made her directorial debut with Memento Mori – Remember Death (2008), and has since created award-winning films including Uteliggernes sang (2010) and Mammas drøm (2016).
Finborud Nøren has also worked widely in television, on productions such as Arven (2018), Et lite stykke Thailand (Gullruten 2008), and 71 Degrees North.
P: +47 951 29 096
